eq083-feasibility-decision-reviewer-repo.decision: Stronger rejection than merely pending admission is justified for this defined configuration-only proposal. Its proposed sufficient controls—guest RAM, PD quotas, route configuration and stop/exit—do not meet mandatory complete resource/writer ownership and bounded physical cleanup. Existing reviews expose specific replenishment, retained allocation, conditional progress and asynchronous or indefinite completion paths that the proposal has no supported enforcement contract to close. Do not select or implement it as EQ083 satisfaction on this evidence.
